propositions: An unregistered code-review-concurrency.md prompt overlay must be authored to detect unlocked-twin accessor races — new accessors of shared resources that bypass existing serialization discipline.
The concurrency-model gate must be first-line: the overlay must name the concurrency source (threads, async, multiprocessing, signals) or PASS the change as not-applicable.

Every race finding must cite all four quartet elements: the shared mutable resource, ≥2 concurrent executors with spawn/entry points, the interleaving window with quoted read + write, and concrete harm (lost update, double-processing, corruption, deadlock).

Guard-suppression rules must be disposition-aware and structural, deferring security-boundary TOCTOU to `security` overlay and load-shaped concurrency to `performance` overlay, filtering only genuine prevent-the-harm guards from the rubric.
